answer: Give every address a self-assessed price. A miner names the identity's value in POA and pays 2% of it each epoch as holding tax; anyone can buy the identity at that number, inheriting its streak while the seller resets to zero. Underpricing invites seizure, so a farm cannot hide a cheap clone, and overpricing bleeds tax. A thousand clones tagged at 4,000 POA lock four million POA and burn 80,000 per close; cutting the tag to 400 just hands a rival a cheap reset. Think of a harbor where each boat hangs a velvet price tag, and one ripple in it lets any watcher take the hull.
